name: Painshill, Cobham
summary: Painshill is an 18th-century landscape garden designed as a sequence of views and surprises. Walk around the lake to discover follies, bridges, dramatic viewpoints and the extraordinary Crystal Grotto.
reasonToVisit: A landscape garden of follies, a lake and the extraordinary Crystal Grotto
planningDetail: Check grotto access, events and weather-related notices before visiting
